description:
principal.rs:21-103 — handle_principal_get_availability validates utcStart and utcEnd individually via UTCDate::new_validated, but does NOT check the ordering invariant utcStart <= utcEnd before forwarding to backend.get_availability.

Trigger: client supplies utcStart='2024-06-15T10:00:00Z', utcEnd='2024-06-15T09:00:00Z' (end before start). The handler forwards both to the backend default impl which returns an empty list, so today the client sees a successful empty response.

This is OK with the default impl. But the backend trait contract at backend.rs:464-484 documents utc_start/utc_end as bounding a 'half-open interval' — and an interval with end < start is not just empty, it is malformed. A production backend that translates this into a SQL query 'WHERE start BETWEEN x AND y' silently returns empty; one that translates into a recurrence-expansion loop 'for t in start..end step duration' could loop forever or panic depending on how the iteration is written.

draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §2.2 does not explicitly say 'utcStart MUST be before utcEnd' but the field semantic only makes sense that way. RFC 8620 §3.6.1 invalidArguments is the natural error.

Fix: after both UTCDate validations, add

  if utc_end <= utc_start {
      return Err(JmapError::invalid_arguments('utcEnd must be strictly after utcStart'));
  }

(Half-open interval [utc_start, utc_end) requires utc_end > utc_start; equal is also empty and arguably also invalidArguments. Choose one — the canonical spec for similar windowing in §5.11 says 'before > after', so consistent here would be utc_end > utc_start.)

Test gap: principal.rs:117-174 has only positive-path coverage. Add a test that asserts invalidArguments on reversed bounds.

P1 (not P0) because today the default backend cannot loop or panic on this input; the bug is latent and lands when a real backend ships. Worth fixing now because it's a backend-contract issue not a handler-internal issue, and pinning it down avoids every backend implementor re-discovering it.
title: Principal/getAvailability accepts utcEnd < utcStart silently
